title: Joint Petition of the Shareholders of Barnstable Bus Co., Inc. Barnstable Bus Co., Inc., Laidlaw Transit, Inc. and Nantucket Island Tours, Inc., requesting that the Department of Public Utilities approve, pursuant to G.L. c. 159A, sec. 7A, the transfer of all of the issued and outstanding shares of capital stock of Barnstable Bus Co., Inc. to Laidlaw Transit, Inc. and the transfer of Charter License No. 5955-HF and certificate of public convenience and necessity No. 3541 to Nantucket Island Tours, Inc.
